The road had an order, the order took time, and everyone could see it [[lpc.term.reconciliation-penitential-discipline]] [[as:paraphrase]].

The Decian persecution made failure common, through certificates that recorded the holder had sacrificed [[lpc.force.decian-persecution-libelli-system]] [[as:paraphrase]]. A person could get one by performing the sacrifice, or by paying to have it recorded [[lpc.force.decian-persecution-libelli-system]] [[as:paraphrase]]. The persecution sorted the congregation into those who had stood and those who had not, and both groups still belonged [[lpc.force.decian-persecution-libelli-system]] [[as:paraphrase]]. Cyprian wrote that when the flock is wounded, the shepherd is wounded most [[lpc.force.decian-persecution-libelli-system]] [[as:paraphrase]].

Confessors issued written requests that named lapsed persons to be received back [[lpc.force.confessors-claim-to-grant-peace]] [[as:paraphrase]]. The contest over the lapsed had to be settled by a formal process, not by a bishop's word alone [[lpc.force.confessors-claim-to-grant-peace]] [[as:paraphrase]].

The sick were not made to wait. Cyprian wrote to his presbyters and deacons: [[quote:lpc.quote.before-even-a-deacon]]

Augustine wrote to Honoratus, a bishop in Mauritania, in 428 or 429 [[lpc.witness.the-dying-and-the-pastors-post]] [[as:paraphrase]]. When danger fell on all alike, Augustine held, ministers must not leave those who depend on them, so that the dying can be baptized and reconciled [[lpc.witness.the-dying-and-the-pastors-post]] [[as:paraphrase]]. Augustine also held that when someone who has sinned against you asks forgiveness, and you forgive from the heart, that much fulfils what the Lord's Prayer asks [[lpc.witness.restless-heart-and-the-unrepentant-enemy]] [[as:paraphrase]].

We can tell you what was decided about a person, how carefully, and by whom [[lpc.limit.ordinary-interior-life]] [[as:paraphrase]]. What an ordinary believer felt walking up to the altar is not ours to give you [[lpc.limit.ordinary-interior-life]] [[as:paraphrase]].

judgement.reason: It shows one response to the failed, a provision for sick penitents holding martyrs' letters, not the church's general response.

question: Every community has failed people at times - how did yours respond when it failed someone?
